item.title: New Algorithm Teaches Robots When to Ask for Human Help
item.description:
New Algorithm Teaches Robots When to Ask for Human Help

Researchers have developed a new algorithm that enables robots to learn when to request human intervention during complex tasks, improving efficiency and reducing unnecessary interruptions.

Source: Learning When a Robot Should Ask For Help: Adaptive Intervention Requests in Human-Robot Teaming
